title: Binary Cross-Entropy Loss
prompt: Derive the gradient of **Binary Cross-Entropy Loss** with respect to the pre-activation logit $z$ ($\hat{y} = \sigma(z)$), and show why it simplifies cleanly to $\frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial z} = \hat{y} - y$.
